# unco_variable_entry (Resource)

Manages a single named entry inside an Unco variable set, leaving sibling entries untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unco_variable_entry" "example" {
  warehouse = "sample-warehouse"
  set_id    = "shared-outputs"
  name      = "EndpointURL"
  kind      = "string"
  target    = "unexported"
  value     = "https://events.example.invalid/queue"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Entry name within the variable set.
- `set_id` (String) Variable set ID within the warehouse.
- `value` (String) Entry value (plain string for `string`/`bytes` kinds, or JSON string for custom kinds).
- `warehouse` (String) Unco warehouse name.

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Entry kind (`string`, `bytes`, or a warehouse custom kind). Defaults to `string`.
- `target` (String) Entry export target (`unexported`, `tfvar`, `env`, `file`, `envfile`, `kubefile`, `tfvarsfile`). Defaults to `unexported`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `<warehouse>/<set_id>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import unco_variable_entry.example sample-warehouse/shared-outputs/EndpointURL
```
